description: The paper root is resolved once per invocation — resolvePaperRoot (CLI: --paper, PENSMITH_PAPER_ROOT, the cwd's .paper/, a new paper, the `pensmith open` pointer) or servicePaperRoot (MCP server and hooks: PENSMITH_PAPER_ROOT, else the working directory) — and recorded with setActivePaperRoot; every later reader calls projectRoot(). Only bin/lib/paths.ts reads the process working directory (projectRoot's fallback, workingDirectory()). A verb, library module, MCP handler or hook that used the working directory as its paper root would ignore --paper, PENSMITH_PAPER_ROOT and the pointer, and write a different paper than the one the dispatcher resolved.
